_comment: Lead design intent for terrain v2 (metres, relative to home at 0,0; +X east, +Y as in phase2_layout). Worker converts to the exact feature schema, may shift features up to 60 m to avoid protected areas, and must report every change. Existing Phase 3 hills, ravine, crater and pit stay where they are.

protected.routes: Scripts/phase2_layout.py route_polylines (max grade stays under 8 percent, width kept clear)

canyons.walls: near-vertical upper 60 percent with 2-3 strata ledges, talus apron on the lower 40 percent; south wall steeper than north

descents.type: switchback path, max grade 22 percent, 3.5 m wide
broken ramp in a side gully, max grade 28 percent
rockfall scramble, readable from the floor

canyons.notes: Cuts through the existing hill near (-340,-290) to expose a tall wall. No inescapable sections: every 250 m of floor has a descent within sight in calm weather.

escarpments.profile: sheer face for the top 35 m, stepped ledges below, boulder talus 40-70 m out from the foot

notch.type: narrow ramp path up through a cleft, max grade 25 percent, 4 m wide

escarpments.notes: The plateau behind keeps gentle relief; the existing far dense field around (850,850) sits on top.

escarpments.profile: sheer with one mid ledge; ends the playable feel of the west edge with a massive drop instead of flat ground

spire_fields.style: few very large monoliths visible as silhouettes from far away

paths.notes: branches off the cruiser route, leads to the north switchback into the Scar; passes the existing pit at a safe distance
from the wreck up to the Shelf notch

path_look: worn, slightly sunken (15-25 cm), compacted darker soil with scattered edge stones and occasional old marker stakes; reads as a track even at 15 m visibility (env_ref_08)

scatter_rules.flats: sparse pebbles and small rocks in wind-aligned clusters, large bare patches
scatter_rules.slopes_20_to_45_deg: medium boulders, denser near the top of slopes
scatter_rules.cliff_feet: talus: many boulders, size decreasing with distance from the wall
scatter_rules.cliff_faces_over_50_deg: large rock-face meshes embedded in the wall to hide stretched landscape, strata-aligned
scatter_rules.ridges_and_rims: jagged teeth and upright slabs along the edge so drops read as dangerous silhouettes
scatter_rules.paths_and_protected: no blocking rocks within the path width; small stones allowed at the edges
scatter_rules.determinism: seed 2042 family; identical on every run
